ban.en: In January, Donald Trump banned 75 countries from applying for visas to the USA.
ban.zh: 在一月份，唐纳德·特朗普禁止了75个国家的公民申请美国签证。

ban.en: For many years, the Rapa Nui language was discouraged or banned in schools.
ban.zh: 多年来，Rapa Nui 语在学校里受到排挤或禁止使用。

ban.en: These were not just the typical countries you might expect Trump to ban.
ban.zh: 这些不仅仅是你可能预料到特朗普会禁止的典型国家。

ban.en: Just ask American cycling legend Lance Armstrong, who was thrown out of the sport for using banned substances.
ban.zh: 去问问美国自行车传奇人物兰斯·阿姆斯特朗（Lance Armstrong）就知道了，他因使用违禁药物而被驱逐出这项运动。

ban.en: And this brings us on to perhaps the best-known of the reforms: the decision to ban the fez.
ban.zh: 这就让我们谈到了或许最著名的改革：禁止戴土耳其fez帽（土耳其红帽）的决定。

battle.en: It is perhaps most famous for The Battle of Anghiari, which took place in 1440.
battle.zh: 它或许最因发生于1440年的安吉亚里战役而闻名。

battle.en: They used to host mock battles, executions, and dramatic performances inside the Colosseum.
battle.zh: 他们过去常常在斗兽场内举办模拟海战、处决和戏剧表演。

battle.en: And when there were battles, they often weren’t battles as you might think of them.
battle.zh: 当发生战斗时，它们往往也不是你想象的那种战斗。

battle.en: He organised coups, he trained militias, he led men into battle across half a continent.
battle.zh: 他组织政变，训练民兵，带领手下在半个大洲的土地上冲锋陷阵。

battle.en: In 1777, American forces achieved a major victory at the Battle of Saratoga in New York.
battle.zh: 1777年，美军在纽约的萨拉托加战役中取得了重大胜利。

ballet.en: Will enjoyed poetry and ballet, and he says this made him an easy target – someone who's vulnerable and easily taken advantage of.
ballet.zh: Will 喜欢诗歌和芭蕾，他说这让他成了'易受欺负的目标'(easy target)——也就是一个脆弱、容易被人利用的人。

ballet.en: The swimmer's movements need to be as graceful as a ballet dancer, and above all, it has to look effortless because judges award points for artistic expression.
ballet.zh: 游泳运动员的动作需要像芭蕾舞演员一样优雅，而且最重要的是，它必须看起来毫不费力，因为裁判会根据艺术表现力来打分。

ballet.en: Here, he tells BBC Radio 4 programme Woman's Hour how it all started: I didn't quite fit in the box – you know, I was doing ballet, I wanted to be an actor, I wrote poetry – and I was an easy target.
ballet.zh: 在 BBC 广播四台节目《Woman's Hour》中，他讲述了这一切是如何开始的：我不太符合那个'框框'——你知道的，我学芭蕾，想当演员，还写诗——所以我很容易成为被针对的对象(easy target)。

bang.en: In fact, the word " slapstick " comes from this world, as in " slapstick comedy", the style of exaggerated comedy where people bang into walls or pretend to hurt themselves.
bang.zh: 事实上，“slapstick”（滑稽闹剧）这个词就源于这个世界，正如“slapstick comedy”（打闹喜剧）那样，这是一种夸张的喜剧风格，人们会撞到墙上或假装伤害自己。

bang.en: Puke is slang for vomit or sick. If something gives bang for your buck, you gain a lot of extra value in return for the money or effort you put into it.
bang.zh: Puke是呕吐或生病的俚语。如果某事物能给你带来“bang for your buck”（物超所值），你投入的金钱或精力就会获得大量额外的价值。

bang.en: Here, Jo Nolan and Michael Rosen discuss the song on BBC Radio 4 programme Word of Mouth: I feel like you get a lot – you get a big bang for your buck in that song.
bang.zh: 在这里，Jo Nolan和Michael Rosen在BBC Radio 4节目Word of Mouth上讨论这首歌：我觉得你得到了很多——你在那首歌里物超所值。

barely.en: It had been almost completely erased. When the war ended in 1945, Warsaw barely existed.
barely.zh: 它几乎被完全从地面上抹去了。当 1945 年战争结束时，华沙已经不复存在。

barely.en: Others were put into solitary confinement —a tiny, dark closet that could barely fit one person.
barely.zh: 还有的人被关进单人禁闭室——一个几乎只能容下一个人的狭小黑暗小隔间。

barely.en: I think on my desk right now I currently have five Japanese textbooks that I barely use.
barely.zh: 我想我现在的桌上目前放着五本我几乎不怎么翻的日语教材。

barely.en: In fact, for much of his early life, he barely registered on the list of potential future kings.
barely.zh: 事实上，在他早年的大部分时间里，他的名字在未来潜在国王的名单上几乎排不上号。

barely.en: And the truth is that I barely use them.
barely.zh: 但事实是，我几乎不用它们。

bark.en: Tauros eat everything from grass and leaves to tree branches and bark, each consuming over 30 kilos a day.
bark.zh: 原牛几乎什么都吃，从青草、树叶到树枝、树皮，每头牛每天要吃掉 30 多公斤。

bark.en: These friendly wolves acted as a natural alarm system, barking when a dangerous predator approached the camp at night, so humans were happy to be followed by wolves.
bark.zh: 这些友善的狼充当了天然的警报系统，当危险的捕食者在夜间接近营地时它们会吠叫，因此人类很乐意让狼跟随着自己。

bait.en: So, it’s not hard to see why many people think rage bait is toxic.
bait.zh: 所以，不难理解为什么许多人认为“愤怒诱饵”是有毒的。

bait.en: But now, a new trend called rage bait is spreading across social media.
bait.zh: 但现在，一种名为“愤怒诱饵”的新趋势正在社交媒体上蔓延。

bait.en: The Romans took the bait and marched through the freezing river, assuming their superior forces would have no problem defeating the seemingly small number of Hannibal’s cavalry.
bait.zh: 罗马人上钩了，冒着冰冷的河水蹚了过来，他们自恃兵力雄厚，消灭Hannibal那看似数量不多的骑兵根本不在话下。

bacteria.en: Darwin’s ideas also affected medicine. Understanding evolution helps doctors now explain how viruses and bacteria adapts and how cancers evolve inside our bodies.
bacteria.zh: Darwin的思想也影响了医学。理解进化论现在可以帮助医生解释病毒和细菌是如何适应环境的，以及癌症如何在我们的体内进化。

bacteria.en: Acne is largely genetic, and the buildup of oil and bacteria in the pores of the skin which causes spots is due to hormones which are completely natural.
bacteria.zh: 痤疮在很大程度上具有遗传性，皮肤毛孔中油脂和细菌的积聚导致了斑刺的出现，这是由于完全自然的荷尔蒙引起的。

bacteria.en: Perhaps it would be lasers that would vaporise material, robotic arms that grind and collect it, or even specialised bacteria, as they do in terrestrial biomining, that break down rock and release valuable metals like nickel or cobalt.
bacteria.zh: 也许会使用激光来汽化物质，用机械臂来研磨和收集，或者甚至像地面生物浸出那样使用特殊的细菌来分解岩石并释放出镍或钴等有价值的金属。

battery.en: Cobalt is the metal that is used in rechargeable batteries, including those that are in electric cars.
battery.zh: 钴是用于可充电电池的金属，包括电动汽车中的电池。

battery.en: The world’s growing demand for electric vehicles and rechargeable batteries has made cobalt and copper super valuable.
battery.zh: 世界对电动汽车和可充电电池不断增长的需求使得钴和铜变得超级宝贵。

battery.en: Cobalt, for example, is a vital part of electric batteries, and 70% of all cobalt is produced in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
battery.zh: 例如，钴是电池中不可或缺的重要部分，而全球 70% 的钴都产自刚果民主共和国。

battery.en: And while batteries are getting cheaper every year, storing enough electricity to keep a country running for days at a time is still a long way off.
battery.zh: 虽然电池每年都在变得更便宜，但要储存足够的电量来维持一个国家连续运行数天，依然还有很长的路要走。

battery.en: Think about a smartphone. Over time, you might replace the screen as it cracks, upgrade the battery, add a new case, or even change the internal parts.
battery.zh: 想想智能手机。随着时间的推移，你可能会在屏幕破裂时更换它、升级电池、添加新外壳，甚至更换内部零件。

backbone.en: They don’t look very exciting, but they are the backbone of the modern digital world.
backbone.zh: 它们看起来不怎么起眼，但它们是现代数字世界的顶梁柱。

backbone.en: These so-called life satisfaction questions are the backbone of most happiness research.
backbone.zh: 这些所谓的对生活满意度的提问是绝大多数幸福研究的基石。

backbone.en: And increasingly, governments have concluded that nuclear and renewables need to work together, with nuclear providing the steady backbone that a renewable -heavy grid needs to actually function.
backbone.zh: 越来越多的政府得出结论，核能和可再生能源需要协同工作，由核能提供稳定的骨干支撑，以使以可再生能源为主的电网能够真正运转。

badge.en: A sheriff’s badge glinting in the sun. This is the Hollywood version.
badge.zh: 警长徽章在阳光下闪闪发光。这就是好莱坞版本的故事。

badge.en: And the badge gave them the authority to do something about it.
badge.zh: 而警徽，则给了他们采取行动的权力。

badge.en: Punch professors trained for years to use one properly, and even today the swazzle is considered the badge of a real Punch and Judy performer.
badge.zh: Punch 教授们要训练多年才能熟练使用它，即使在今天，swazzle 也被视为真正的 Punch and Judy 表演者的徽章。

baron.en: Then, in 1215, came Magna Carta — the great document forced on King John by his barons.
baron.zh: 然后，到了1215年，《大宪章》(Magna Carta)问世——这是由男爵们强迫约翰(King John)国王签署的一份伟大文件。

baron.en: Under this policy, they would give up their traditional Gaelic titles, acknowledge Henry as king, and receive their lands back as English-style grants with titles like Earl or Baron.
baron.zh: 根据这项政策，他们将放弃传统的盖尔头衔，承认 Henry 为国王，并以伯爵或男爵等英国式头衔重新获得自己的土地。

baron.en: And in part three, in the interests of balance, we will talk about Manfred von Richthofen, a German aircraft pilot so deadly he was known to his enemies as “The Red Baron”.
baron.zh: 在第三集中，为了平衡起见，我们将聊聊 Manfred von Richthofen。他是一位极其致命的德国飞行员，被敌人称为“红男爵”。

baron.en: The first was all the way back in 1215, when the then King John I was forced by a group of powerful English barons to sign a document called the Magna Carta.
baron.zh: 第一个要追溯到1215年，当时的国王约翰一世被一群强大的英国男爵逼迫签署了一份名为《大宪章》的文件。

bargain.en: In the end, he avoided a potentially lengthy and highly publicised trial by accepting a plea bargain.
bargain.zh: 最后，他通过接受认罪协议，避免了一场可能旷日持久且备受瞩目的审判。

bargain.en: People would be at the mercy of employers who could pay as little as they liked, especially in industries where workers have very little bargaining power.
bargain.zh: 人们将任由雇主摆布，雇主想付多少就付多少，尤其是在工人几乎没有议价能力的行业。

bargain.en: Two Roman legions were sent across the Mediterranean to face Hannibal, but when they arrived, they found that Hannibal had done something they hadn’t bargained for.
bargain.zh: 两个罗马军团被派往地中海迎战Hannibal，但当他们抵达时，发现Hannibal做了他们始料未及的事。

banker.en: In places like northern Italy, new city-states were booming with merchants, bankers and notaries.
banker.zh: 在意大利北部等地，新兴的城邦里商贾云集，银行家和公证人活跃。

banquet.en: Some even had perfume fountains at their extravagant banquets, spraying scented mist over their guests.
banquet.zh: 有些人甚至在他们奢侈的宴会上设置了香水喷泉，向客人们喷洒带香味的雾气。

banquet.en: In the case of today’s protagonist, at the age of 25, his favourite drink–and his only contribution to his wedding banquet –was a single crate of beer, but at 45, his tastes had evolved.
banquet.zh: 对于今天的主人公来说，在25岁时，他最喜欢的饮料——也是他为婚宴准备的唯一贡品——只是一箱啤酒，但到了45岁，他的品味已经升级了。

banquet.en: He is said to have prostituted the wives of noblemen, inviting senators and their wives to banquets, then forcing the wives, one by one, into side rooms, forcing them to have sex with him and then describing their performance in intimate detail, publicly, in front of their husbands.
banquet.zh: 据说他出卖贵族们的妻子，邀请元老院议员和他们的妻子参加宴会，然后强迫这些妻子一个接一个地进入侧室，强迫她们与他发生性关系，接着在她们的丈夫面前公开、极其细致地描述她们的表现。

bay.en: The explorers had entered Guanabara Bay, the large natural harbour but not a river.
bay.zh: 探险家们进入的是瓜纳巴拉湾这个巨大的天然港口，而不是一条河。

bay.en: Finally, in 1567, the Portuguese defeated the French and secured control of Guanabara Bay.
bay.zh: 最终，在1567年，葡萄牙人击败了法国人，确保了对瓜纳巴拉湾的控制。

bay.en: The Northern Colonies, often known as New England, included New Hampshire, Massachusetts Bay, Rhode Island, and Connecticut.
bay.zh: 北部殖民地通常被称为新英格兰，包括新罕布什尔、马萨诸塞湾、罗德岛和康涅狄格。

bay.en: He built pleasure-galleys to cruise the Bay of Naples: vast ships with baths, colonnades, banquet-halls and even vines.
bay.zh: 他建造了游艇去巡游那不勒斯湾：配有浴室、柱廊、宴会厅甚至葡萄藤的巨大船只。

barge.en: In a lake just south of Rome, Lake Nemi, he launched colossal barges with marble flooring.
barge.zh: 在罗马南部的一个湖泊 Nemi 湖中，他下水了带有大理石地板的庞大驳船。

barge.en: As a quick side note for the seriously dedicated listeners among you, you may remember these barges from episode number 516, on the history of underwater exploration.
barge.zh: 顺便提一下，对于节目中那些极其忠实的听众，你们可能还记得来自第516集关于水下探索历史的这些驳船。

barge.en: At the bottom of this lake lay two huge ancient barges that had been built as floating palaces for the Roman Emperor Caligula in the first century AD.
barge.zh: 在这个湖底躺着两艘巨大的古代驳船，它们是公元1世纪为罗马皇帝卡利古拉（Caligula）建造的水上宫殿。

batch.en: They would take the drugs, and then, being good internet citizens, they would leave a review: “really good batch”, or “the pink ones aren’t as strong as the blue ones”, or simply, “great communication, A+ seller, will buy again!”.
batch.zh: 他们会吸食这些毒品，然后，作为优秀的网民，他们会留下评价：“这批货真的很棒”，或者“粉色的没有蓝色的劲大”，或者干脆写道：“沟通顺畅，A+卖家，还会再买！”。

basement.en: After this mock arrest process, the prisoners were blindfolded and transported to the basement of Stanford University’s psychology building, which had been transformed into a makeshift prison.
basement.zh: 经过这场模拟逮捕后，囚犯们被蒙上眼睛，送往斯坦福大学心理学系大楼的地下室——那里已经被改造成一座临时监狱。

bandit.en: It was long, and the route was filled with bandits and hostile forces.
bandit.zh: 路途遥远，沿途布满了强盗和敌对势力。

barrel.en: Pork barrel refers to government spending on local projects designed to please voters or legislators.
barrel.zh: 猪肉桶是指政府对地方项目的支出，旨在取悦选民或议员。

barrel.en: What we know is that it was basically a large wooden barrel with a small piece of crystal for a window.
barrel.zh: 我们所知道的是，它基本上是一个大木桶，带有一小块水晶作为窗户。

barrel.en: There was an example of pork barrel politics or pork barreling in the London area of Tower Hamlets a few years ago.
barrel.zh: 几年前，在伦敦陶尔哈姆莱茨（Tower Hamlets）地区，就有一个关于猪肉桶政治或搞猪肉桶项目的例子。

barrel.en: If there is less oil being sold, the prices of oil will be higher, which increases the profit you can make from each barrel of oil you sell.
barrel.zh: 如果出售的石油减少，油价就会更高，这会增加你从销售的每一桶油中获得的利润。

barrel.en: The price of oil skyrocketed, going from $2.90 a barrel before the embargo to $11.65 a barrel in January of 1974, a more than four times increase.
barrel.zh: 油价急剧飙升，从禁运前的每桶2.90美元飙升至1974年1月的每桶11.65美元，涨幅超过四倍。

bankruptcy.en: He was drowning in debt, and was at risk of having to declare personal bankruptcy.
bankruptcy.zh: 他债台高筑，面临着不得不宣布个人破产的风险。

bankruptcy.en: And the UK isn’t quite as forgiving as countries like the United States when it comes to bankruptcy.
bankruptcy.zh: 在破产问题上，英国并不像美国等国家那样宽容。

bacon.en: Items like meat, butter, bacon, sugar, eggs, and cheese were restricted.
bacon.zh: 肉类、黄油、培根、糖、鸡蛋和奶酪等物品都受到了限制。

bacon.en: For breakfast, you can try full English breakfasts: eggs, bacon, sausages, beans, mushrooms, tomatoes, and toast, sometimes black pudding as well.
bacon.zh: 早餐方面，你可以尝试英式全套早餐：鸡蛋、培根、香肠、茄汁豆、蘑菇、西红柿和吐司，有时还有黑布丁。

barrier.en: These temporary barriers were soon replaced by a complex and heavily fortified wall system.
barrier.zh: 这些临时屏障很快就被一个复杂且戒备森严的墙体系统所取代。

barrier.en: The Berlin Wall was actually a network of concrete barriers, guard towers, flood lights, alarm systems, and patrol roads.
barrier.zh: 柏林墙实际上是一个由混凝土屏障、岗楼、探照灯、报警系统和巡逻路组成的网络。

barrier.en: By managing code switching intentionally, I think you can use it as a tool instead of letting it become a barrier to your learning.​
barrier.zh: 通过有意识地管理语码转换，我认为你可以把它当作一个工具，而不是让它成为你学习的障碍。

barrier.en: While Maria showed a strong curiosity and love for learning from a young age, as a woman in the late 19th century, she faced significant barriers.
barrier.zh: 尽管玛丽从小就表现出强烈的好奇心和对学习的热爱，但作为 19 世纪末的女性，她面临着巨大的阻碍。

barrier.en: This removed barriers to trade, standardized some regulations (which made regulations the same across different countries), and also allowed for the free movement of people and goods and services.
barrier.zh: 这消除了贸易壁垒，统一了一些规章制度（也就是使不同国家的规章制度保持一致），并且允许人员、货物和服务的自由流动。

barley.en: According to a tablet from 5000 years ago, we know Kushim was responsible for the production and storage of barley, and he signed his name on his tablet.
barley.zh: 根据一块5年前的泥板，我们知道库什姆负责大麦的生产和储存，他在自己的泥板上签了名。

bankrupt.en: By 2000, reality began to catch up. Many companies failed and went bankrupt.
bankrupt.zh: 到2000年，现实开始显现。许多公司失败并破产。

bankrupt.en: Less than a year later, the company was bankrupt and gone.
bankrupt.zh: 不到一年后，该公司就宣告破产并消亡了。

basin.en: This is a high altitude basin surrounded by mountains and lakes.
basin.zh: 这是一个被群山和湖泊环绕的高海拔盆地。

basin.en: A high altitude basin is a large, flat area of land that is surrounded by mountains and is located high above the sea level.
basin.zh: 高海拔盆地是指一块周围环绕着山脉、且位于海平面较高位置的大片平坦土地。
